Ahmed Fatouh.note: Fatouh stands out for choosing the moment to join an attack from deep. He turns early and protects the route toward goal. He looks up before crossing and picks a runner rather than an empty area.
Ahmed Fatouh.noteZh: 他的突出特点是从后场加入进攻的启动时机。他会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。他也会传中前先观察，再把球送向具体跑动者。

Emam Ashour.note: Ashour stands out for creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He moves after releasing the ball so the receiver still has support. He moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back.
Emam Ashour.noteZh: 他的突出特点是在防线重组前制造干净射门。他会出球后继续移动，让接球队友始终有支援。他也会从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。

Haissem Hassan.note: Hassan's edge is seeing the decisive pass one beat before it opens. He draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap. He changes his position early enough to give the passer a clear target.
Haissem Hassan.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是比防线早一步看到决定性的传球。他会主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。他也会提前改变位置，为传球队友提供清晰目标。

Hamdy Fathy.note: Fathy's signature is protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass.
Hamdy Fathy.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢上。他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会第一脚触球先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。

Hamza Abdelkarim.note: Abdelkarim's signature is starting his run while defenders are still watching the ball. He angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball. He changes his position early enough to give the passer a clear target.
Hamza Abdelkarim.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在在防守者仍盯着球时提前启动上。他会接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。他也会提前改变位置，为传球队友提供清晰目标。

Hossam Abdelmaguid.note: Abdelmaguid's edge is making the safer decision before a duel becomes an emergency. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He holds the route into the box until support arrives.
Hossam Abdelmaguid.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是在对抗变成险情前做出更安全的选择。他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Ibrahim Adel.note: Adel stands out for explosive speed once open grass appears. He shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift. He moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back.
Ibrahim Adel.noteZh: 他的突出特点是看到空当后的爆发速度。他会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。他也会从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。

Karim Hafez.note: Watch Hafez for seeing the decisive pass one beat before it opens. He changes position while keeping his priorities simple. He looks up before crossing and picks a runner rather than an empty area.
Karim Hafez.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是比防线早一步看到决定性的传球。留意他如何改变起始位置，但始终坚持清晰简单的处理原则。他也会传中前先观察，再把球送向具体跑动者。

Mahdy Soliman.note: Soliman is defined by staying ready through long quiet spells. He sets his feet before the shot and reacts without an extra step. He judges when to leave his line and takes pressure off his defenders.
Mahdy Soliman.noteZh: 他靠在长时间无事可做后依然保持专注与同位置球员拉开差异。他会在射门前站稳脚步，再用最少动作完成扑救。他也会判断何时出击，替后卫化解高球压力。

Mahmoud Saber.note: Saber stands out for creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it.
Mahmoud Saber.noteZh: 他的突出特点是在防线重组前制造干净射门。他会接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。他也会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。

Marawan Attia.note: Attia stands out for seeing the decisive pass one beat before it opens. He holds the passing lane into midfield until support arrives. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball.
Marawan Attia.noteZh: 他的突出特点是比防线早一步看到决定性的传球。他会守住通向中场核心区域的传球线路，直到队友能对持球人施压。他也会等对手触球稍大后再连人带球一起压上。

Mohamed Abdelmoneim.summary: Mohamed Abdelmoneim is an Egypt centre-back from OGC Nice who gives the national team front-foot defending, aerial power, and aggressive stepping.
Mohamed Abdelmoneim.note: Abdelmonem stands out for choosing the moment of contact instead of diving in. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He holds the route into the box until support arrives.
Mohamed Abdelmoneim.noteZh: 他的突出特点是选择身体接触时机，而不是贸然上抢。他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Mohamed Alaa.note: Watch Alaa for the flexibility to fill different roles without breaking the team's shape. He holds the route into the box until support arrives. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it.
Mohamed Alaa.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是在多个角色之间切换时仍保持球队结构。留意他如何守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。他也会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。

Mohamed El Shenawy.note: Watch Shenawy for organizing teammates before danger becomes obvious. He sets his feet before the shot and reacts without an extra step. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass.
Mohamed El Shenawy.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是在危险出现前组织好队友。留意他如何在射门前站稳脚步，再用最少动作完成扑救。他也会第一脚触球先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。

Mohamed Hany.note: Hany stands out for seeing the decisive pass one beat before it opens. He holds the route into the box until support arrives. He waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him.
Mohamed Hany.noteZh: 他的突出特点是比防线早一步看到决定性的传球。他会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。他也会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。

Mohamed Salah.note: Watch Salah for creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He draws a defender in and releases the runner behind him. He changes his position early enough to give the passer a clear target.
Mohamed Salah.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是在防线重组前制造干净射门。留意他如何先吸引防守者靠近，再把球送到其身后的跑动线路。他也会提前改变位置，为传球队友提供清晰目标。

Mohanad Lashin.summary: Mohanad Lashin is an Egypt defensive midfielder from Pyramids FC who gives the national team central coverage, ball winning, and simple progression.
Mohanad Lashin.note: Watch Lasheen for protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it.
Mohanad Lashin.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。留意他如何等对手触球稍大后再连人带球一起压上。他也会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。

Mostafa Shoubir.summary: Mostafa Shoubir is an Egypt goalkeeper from Al Ahly who gives the national team reaction saves, line command, and close-range stops.
Mostafa Shoubir.note: Shobeir's signature is sharp reactions backed by early positioning. He keeps the line connected with constant small instructions. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it.
Mostafa Shoubir.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在提前站位后的快速反应上。他会用持续而简短的提醒保持整条防线连接。他也会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。

Mostafa Zico.note: Ziko stands out for creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He draws a defender in and releases the runner behind him. He changes his position early enough to give the passer a clear target.
Mostafa Zico.noteZh: 他的突出特点是在防线重组前制造干净射门。他会先吸引防守者靠近，再把球送到其身后的跑动线路。他也会提前改变位置，为传球队友提供清晰目标。

Nabil Donga.note: Watch Emad for choosing the moment of contact instead of diving in. He positions himself for the next touch before the first contest is over. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass.
Nabil Donga.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是选择身体接触时机，而不是贸然上抢。留意他如何第一次争抢还没结束，就先为下一脚触球站好位置。他也会第一脚触球先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。

Omar Marmoush.note: Marmoush's signature is making purposeful movement away from the ball. He changes pace after the defender has committed his feet. He shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift.
Omar Marmoush.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在用有目的的无球移动创造接应点上。他会等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。他也会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。

Ramy Rabia.note: Watch Rabia for calm decisions shaped by experience in high-pressure moments. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He varies the height and pace of his delivery.
Ramy Rabia.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是高压时刻由经验带来的冷静判断。留意他如何主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会通过改变落点和球速寻找防线最薄弱的区域。

Tarek Alaa.summary: Tarek Alaa is an Egypt right-back from ZED FC who gives the national team right-side defending, overlap energy, and recovery runs.
Tarek Alaa.note: Alaa's edge is protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him. He turns early and protects the route toward goal.
Tarek Alaa.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。他会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。他也会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。

Trezeguet.note: Watch Trézéguet for creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He draws a defender in and releases the runner behind him. He changes his position early enough to give the passer a clear target.
Trezeguet.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是在防线重组前制造干净射门。留意他如何先吸引防守者靠近，再把球送到其身后的跑动线路。他也会提前改变位置，为传球队友提供清晰目标。

Yasser Ibrahim.note: Ibrahim stands out for creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He holds the route into the box until support arrives. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it.
Yasser Ibrahim.noteZh: 他的突出特点是在防线重组前制造干净射门。他会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。他也会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。

Zizo.note: Zizo's edge is delivering the ball without needing much space. He varies the height and pace of his delivery. He shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift.
Zizo.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是在很小空间里也能送出传中的能力。他会通过改变落点和球速寻找防线最薄弱的区域。他也会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。
